title: MerchantStatement
description: One month of a merchant's card processing statement, normalized. This is the input to the statement review, which is the sales conversation in SMB payments. Fill what the statement shows; leave unknown fees null and the calculator will say what it cannot conclude.

processor.description: Current processor as printed. Used for the competitor field, never in copy.

card_present_share.description: Share of volume swiped/dipped/tapped. Null if the statement does not split it.

pricing_model.description: interchange_plus itemizes interchange and markup. tiered shows qualified/mid/non-qualified buckets. flat_rate is one blended percent plus per item. subscription is a monthly fee plus pass-through.

fees.description: Dollar amounts for the period. Null means not shown on the statement, which is itself a finding.

total.description: Everything the merchant paid for processing this month.

interchange.description: Pass-through to issuing banks. Only itemized on interchange_plus statements.

assessments.description: Card brand fees (Visa, Mastercard, Discover, Amex network). Pass-through.

monthly_fixed.description: Statement fee, gateway, batch, account fees.

other.description: Anything not above. Chargeback fees, annual fees prorated, junk fees.

notes.description: What the rep noticed that the fields do not capture.
